measurement.S: The held-model reading (reading 3 of commute.held_model, the working definition's held model; plan 'The request'): M = W0, F = W0 + δW (196 linear matrices; norms and embeddings W0's). At each layer's o_proj (units: 16 heads x 128 outputs) and down_proj (units: 6,144 MLP activations), a^M are M's units and w^F is F's write, both on M's input to that layer. H = M with each output matrix replaced by A = C G^+, C = sum w^F' a^M, G = sum a^M' a^M (fp64) over the 16,384 fit positions (maths rows 0-63); G^+ at torch's default hermitian tolerance. S = 1 - KL(F||H) / KL(F||M), each the mean per position over every position of maths rows 64-127 (16,384); 'no change' (None) when KL(F||M) <= the floor (settings s_floor_source). Per site the fit residual |w^F - a^M A'|^2 / |w^F|^2 on the fit rows; on the read rows too for the controls and the random changes. Code: src/commute/qwen_held.py, experiments/qwen_held_readings/run.py Held
measurement.S_random: Per state, an iid Gaussian change (draw 0, per matrix seed null_seed(0, site)) scaled to the state's Frobenius norm at each of the 196 matrices, read for S by the same code
measurement.share: E57's re-gating share (K00 - K01) / (K00 - K11), cells summed over the 128 maths rows of 256, status by qwen_reading.shares (floor 0.05 nats a position on the denominator), on p-015e0710 with every change's attention matrices set to zero (MLP only, lead's decision 2026-11-13), split by the Lab's least-squares split (Σ on 128 maths rows of 512). Each read's mean K0 must equal stage 0's floor within 1e-3
measurement.curve: E186's: Gaussian draws 0-2 at R_s0's 84 MLP per-matrix norms, each with one split, scale b searched (share_reading.size_search, power 2, on 32 rows, within 1.05, up to 8 evaluations) so K00 - K0 lands at each of three sizes, read on 128 rows (share_reading.read_at_sizes, moved from share_reference.random_draw unchanged in effect). Sizes from the scored states' K00 (settings widen). Curve and band: share_reading.curve and band over usable draws (scored, K00 within 1.1x of its target)
measurement.erank: update_spectrum (P3.6's definition): per matrix exp of the entropy of the normalised singular values (fp64 svdvals, on the GPU), averaged over the 196 matrices weighted by |δW_m|^2; the floor is the same average of two Gaussian draws' per-matrix eranks weighted by the state's norms

blind_to.S: Whether F's units are M's units re-weighted or new directions that M's units happen to span on 16,384 positions: with 2.7 fit positions per MLP input, any write is fitted in-sample and the read rows carry the fit noise (plan flag 5); its random change at the same norms shares the fit size and rows. Attention patterns that F changes enter only through w^F at o_proj
blind_to.share: Attention entirely (p-015e0710 decomposes the MLP only); which neurons moved
blind_to.erank: Which units the change uses; a low-rank change and a sparse one can read alike

S.rule: summary.s_rule, filed for RL (seeds 0, 70): gap = S(state) - S(its random change) per seed; 'above random' (rival A) if every gap > 0.02; 'below random' if every gap < -0.02; 'like random' (rival B) if every |gap| <= 0.02 or the gaps have both signs; 'mixed' otherwise; 'unreadable' if any S of the pair reads 'no change'. Rounded to 9 places. The collapsed run and own-samples SFT are read by the same function and described, not ruled

rules.share: Each state placed on the random curve at its own K00 (share_reading.place): 'above' if share - curve > band, 'below' if < -band, 'inside' otherwise; 'unreadable' if unscored, off the curve's span by more than 1.1x, or no band; own-samples SFT unscored reads 'does not apply'. A description: no outcome over states is filed (n = 2 a run)
rules.erank: Reported with the floor and the gap; no rule (P3.6 already filed its comparison on these readings)
